first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone's dataset-specific CRS and archive-internal DTM tile filename. This unused official Spatial NI Data Preparation Guide window establishes that Spatial NI accepts Irish Grid TM65 (EPSG:29902), Irish Grid TM75 (EPSG:29903), and Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), and states that Spatial NI does not provide transformation or processing of supplied data. The guide therefore narrows the official CRS possibilities but does not identify which CRS was used by the Belfast City 2006 LiDAR North East Zone; without dataset-specific CRS metadata or readable archive bytes, no CRS choice, tile filename, geometry or parcel binding is fabricated.
